name: A photographic plate: a thin sheet of clear glass carrying its emulsion (an autochrome's screen and image)

roughness.note: The varnished emulsion is sealed under a cover glass bound to the plate: both faces are smooth glass.

roughnessAcross.source: a glass face has no grain

haziness.note: One specular lobe until a goniometric measurement shows a second.

relief.derivation: no relief is drawn over the work's own image

paneThickness.note: The plate and the cover glass bound over it, each a thin sheet of about 1.5 mm; no measured plate was read.
